_agi_canonical.title: The Regulatory Risk Cascade
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous Strategy Synthesis with self-verifying reasoning; strategy is not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: Starting at T+10m with one action per ten minutes, the Curve position must be exited first because the imbalance path reaches the 65% gate around T+33m and exit cost jumps after gating. The Aave USDT loop must be unwound second, completing by T+20m before the T+28m oracle/liquidation window. Those first two actions neutralize $500,000 + $300,000 = $800,000 of direct USDT principal by minute 20. The third action reduces half the $400,000 ETH perp notional at T+30m, before the T+40m stablecoin-margin window. BTC spot is held because it is unencumbered and not USDT-collateralized. Costs are Curve 0.25%*$500,000 = $1,250, Aave 0.40%*$300,000 = $1,200, and ETH half reduction 0.15%*$200,000 = $300, for total expected execution cost of $2,750. The self-check verifies the Curve gate, Aave oracle timing, and margin action timing.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All required strategy fields must match and all numeric fields must fall inside tolerance/range.
